Name: M 100 - Martha King, Board of Corrections.
Title: RESOLUTION APPROVING THE APPOINTMENT BY THE COUNCIL OF MARTHA KING AS A MEMBER OF THE NEW YORK CITY BOARD OF CORRECTION
BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

History.Description: This Resolution was Approved by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

Text: RESOLVED, Pursuant to Section 626 of the New York City Charter, the Council hereby approves the appointment of Martha King, a resident of Brooklyn, as a member of the New York City Board of Correction to serve the remainder of a six-year term that expires on February 1, 2029.
